song.lyrics:
Isai displays lyrics and guitar chords for live worship performance.
Point it at a URL containing your songs XML file by going to Settings and entering the address, or scan a QR code to configure it automatically.
The app caches your library locally so it works offline between refreshes.
While viewing a song you can: - Auto-scroll at adjustable speed (Play button) - Transpose chords up or down (arrows above lyrics) - See the capo fret when specified by the song
song.title: How This App Is Used
